Cody Laux <cody@scs.unr.edu> wrote:
>	1. Can you transfer equipment from a vampire in torpor to a 
>vampire not in torpor?

Your minions can grab equipment from your torpored vampires
via the equip action, yes.

>	2. Can you use cards such as fast hands at long range?

It doesn't say it's usable at long range, so no.

>	3. Does a vampire go to torpor immediatly after going below zero 
>or receiving aggravated damage, or does it have time to do additional 
>strikes and stuff?

Immediately.
